provenance_note: The isolated gateway served this repository's own copy of the app: capture.py's setup installed it from this checkout (POST /api/apps/install), trusted it and enabled it, and every picture shows its committed bundle (ui/dist/index.mjs) and backend. Kiro Crew still ships a built-in spec-builder and refuses a second install under the same name, so the Kiro Crew tree the capture ran on is the App Kit level-1 commit the tests pin, with only the built-in copy removed (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/spec_builder and its BUILTIN_NAMES row); kirocrew_tree_dirty records that. The folder picker's first listing (the gateway user's home folder) was sent to the demo projects folder instead, so no real home folder appears; the app answered that listing as it answers any folder.
data_notes: The project is a made-up library holds service (Fernleaf Library, capture/fixtures/fernleaf-library), copied for each gateway to /tmp/spec-builder-demo/fernleaf-library and committed there by a fictional author. Every name and the .example email addresses in it are invented.

The specs were created through the app's own New spec form (the walkthrough) and its POST /specs route (the bug spec), so the agent's first message, its questions and every document came from a live model and differ from run to run.
The agent's tool calls were approved with the chat's own Trust button, as a person would.
